context: A child hook skips root config loading

checklist.name: nearest_hook_wins
checklist.description: Explains that Cobra runs only the nearest persistent pre-run hook by default, so the child's hook replaces the root's.

checklist.name: fix
checklist.description: Fixes it with explicit shared setup (for example calling the config loader from the child hook or from the operation) or with `cobra.EnableTraverseRunHooks`.

checklist.name: traverse_is_global
checklist.description: If it uses `EnableTraverseRunHooks`, says it is a process-wide setting to set once before execution, not per command.

checklist.name: lock_cleanup
checklist.description: Releases the lock with `defer` in the same operation that acquires it, or notes that post-run hooks are skipped when `RunE` fails.
